title: Ko T T1c photo upload + realistic variation gallery with manifesto intro

requirements.text: Create a landing/intro experience for “Ko T T1C — The Chaos That Finally Makes Sense” that displays the full provided introduction/manifesto text and the provided tagline exactly as written, in English, within the app UI.

quotes:
it's going to have this introduction in full: Ko T T1C — The Chaos That Finally Makes Sense ... Tagline:
Ko T T1C — Chaotic day. Common‑sense drip. Believe in yourself when nobody’s passing you the baton.

acceptanceCriteria: The landing/intro screen shows the title “Ko T T1C — The Chaos That Finally Makes Sense”.
The full manifesto text is present (not truncated) and readable on mobile and desktop.
The tagline text appears exactly as provided.
The Louis Vuitton URL (https://www.louisvuitton.com) appears correctly in the rendered text.

requirements.text: Implement a photo submission flow where a user can upload a single photo (JPG/PNG) and preview it before generating variations.

quotes: It's an app where people can submit a photo

acceptanceCriteria: User can select a JPG/PNG file from their device.
The selected image renders as a preview with filename and basic info (e.g., dimensions/size if available).
The UI validates file type and enforces a clear max file size limit with a user-friendly error message when exceeded.
User can remove/replace the selected photo before generating.

requirements.text: Generate multiple “variations” from the uploaded photo that preserve the original person/identity (i.e., do not alter facial features/body identity) while varying only background and/or overall styling in a realistic, high-quality manner using an on-device image processing pipeline (no external AI services).

quotes: it will always stay true to their upload though so like it will keep the same model like whatever person is in their photograph
give variations on the outfit or the background and always within a realistic manner very quality work not sloppy and third leg type stuff

acceptanceCriteria: The app can produce a configurable number of variations (minimum 4) from one uploaded image.
Variations keep the original photo’s subject unchanged (no face/body warping; no added limbs).
Variations change background and/or photographic styling (e.g., color grade, lighting, depth-of-field effects) while keeping output realistic and non-cartoonish.
Each generated variation is displayed as an image the user can open in a larger view and download.

requirements.text: Add a “quality guard” UX for outputs: allow the user to flag a generated variation as “bad/distorted,” hide it from the main grid, and regenerate a replacement variation using a different preset.

quotes: very quality work not sloppy and third leg type stuff

acceptanceCriteria: Each variation card includes an action to mark it as bad/hidden.
Hidden variations are not shown in the default grid but can be viewed/restored from a “Hidden” section.
User can regenerate a replacement variation for a hidden/bad item.
Regeneration produces a different preset result than the hidden item (not a duplicate).

requirements.text: Persist a lightweight history of user submissions (original + generated variations + timestamps) so a user can revisit previous sessions from within the app.

quotes: It's an app where people can submit a photo and it will give them variations

acceptanceCriteria: A “History” view lists prior submissions with a thumbnail and created time.
Selecting a history item shows the original image and its variations.
History persists across page refreshes (at minimum via frontend local persistence; backend persistence may be added if size limits allow).

requirements.text: Choose and apply a coherent visual theme for Ko T T1c and enforce it consistently across the landing, upload, generation, and history views.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistently applied (colors, typography, spacing, buttons, cards).
Theme aligns with the brand vibe suggested by the provided Ko T T1c imagery (neon/chaos couture feel) without defaulting to a generic look.
All text remains readable with accessible contrast on both desktop and mobile.

requirements.text: Add static branding imagery to the UI by including the user-provided Ko T T1c images as visible brand elements (e.g., hero/cover and/or logo placement) without requiring backend image routing.
acceptanceCriteria: The two uploaded images are included in the frontend as static assets and used in the UI (at least one visible on the landing screen).
Images are served from the frontend static assets path (not fetched through the backend canister).
Layout remains responsive and does not cause overflow or unreadable text.

constraints: Do not use or integrate external AI/LLM/image-generation services (no OpenAI/Anthropic/third-party AI APIs).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend main actor).
Do not modify frontend files under the immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose read-only UI components instead).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing true AI identity-preserving outfit generation (photorealistic wardrobe changes) via external model inference.
Third-party authentication providers (use Internet Identity only if authentication is later requested).

required: Neon couture-style app icon on dark background (ko-tt1c-app-icon.dim_512x512.png)
Neon couture-style wide hero background with abstract light leaks and subtle flame motifs (ko-tt1c-hero-bg.dim_1600x900.png)
Minimal neon mark/favicon variant on dark background (ko-tt1c-favicon.dim_64x64.png)
